04 / Your questions

A little more
clarity.

Practical answers for a thoughtful next step.

How do I know which care service to explore?

Start with daily needs and the treating clinician’s recommendations. Nursing, physiotherapy, and everyday assistance have different roles. A clinical assessment may be needed to determine the right level of care.

Can I plan support before hospital discharge?

Planning ahead gives you time to discuss discharge advice, the home environment, equipment if needed, and service availability. Confirm the plan with the treating team before making arrangements.

What should be included in a care quote?

Ask for the service, visit or shift length, tasks included, caregiver role, and any additional charges. Confirm deposits, cancellation terms, and payment arrangements in writing.

What information should I have ready?

Your location, preferred timing, and the kind of assistance you need are useful starting points. Share medical information only through an agreed secure channel when appropriate.
